basic_info.description: Welcome to this sweet condo perfect for beach lovers. Views of the ocean from the living room and remodeled kitchen. Two well-sized bedrooms and one bath. Great closet space. Magical, serene garden with outdoor shower. One-car parking, shared washer/dryer, and plenty of space for surf boards behind the garage. Steps to the beach and Taraval Street where you can grab coffee at Andytown Roasters, cocktails at White Cap, French food at Galinette and Cal-Mex at Underdogs Too.
